result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a loading indicator stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image obscures content and signals an incomplete load, while the rest of the page appears intact.

issues.description: White circular loading spinner is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the food photo and making the card look broken/incompletely loaded.
issues.suggestion: Fix image loading so the spinner dismisses once loaded; preload images and add a fallback placeholder and retry/error state if load fails.
